analysis_scope: Closed E19 public robot kinematics and applied actions only; no cloth geometry, audit, evaluator, model or physics calls.
units: metres, seconds, radians unless key explicitly says degrees
grasp_pose_semantics: Public robot gripper reference frame; not the true cloth attachment point or a contact sensor.

method.arm_extension: sum of four measured prismatic arm joint positions
method.target_increment: normalized action arm_extension * public ARM_RATE * model_steps/20
method.settle_scope: All selected intervals include the explicitly recorded 6 neutral controller steps; existing joint targets persist.
method.public_dataset_selection: policy.hdf5 data/demo_0 public obs fields at boundaries801..931, plus next_obs at931 for boundary932. No RGB, depth, audit or evaluation datasets opened.
